selector.exact: To correct a time, add the harbour's fixed offset of twenty-two minutes to every high water and eighteen minutes to every low water. The offset was measured over a full year and has not changed since the breakwater was built.
selector.prefix: ur before it goes on the board.
selector.suffix: Wind can move the water further

suggestion.original:
To correct a time, add the harbour's fixed offset of twenty-two minutes to
every high water and eighteen minutes to every low water. The offset was
measured over a full year and has not changed since the breakwater was built.
suggestion.replacement:
To correct a time, always add the harbour's fixed offset of twenty-two minutes to
every high water and eighteen minutes to every low water. The offset was
measured over a full year and has not changed since the breakwater was built.
